verdict.rationale: Missive documents search filters for Type (Internal/External) and Date range, which now work without a search term. Its command bar can search across all messages, contacts, or messages inside a specific label. That covers basic filtered search across mail, but none of the power-user depth the story asks for is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented search operators/query syntax, ranked or relevance-ordered results, evidence of search speed, explicit coverage of full mail history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
